# Adrian Treleaven

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c23 P5](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0005), [v4 c23 P8](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0008), [v4 c23 P10](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** Author and writer  <sub>[v4 c39 P5](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0005), [v4 c23 P0](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Adrian Treleaven is a tall, broad-shouldered man with dense brown hair and luminous dark-gray eyes. He has a sharp nose and chin, as well as pleasingly shaped ears and white teeth that reveal themselves when he smiles. Though his face appears somber, enigmatic, and sorrowful when not smiling, a candid and charming smile illuminates his features with wit and attractiveness.

_Sources: [v4 c23 P8](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0008), [v4 c23 P9](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0009), [v4 c23 P10](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0010)_

## Personality

Adrian is warm, amiable, and expressive, possessing a strong sense of humor and enthusiasm for history and romantic sentiment. He holds a deep appreciation for meaningful symbolism, such as red roses representing victorious love, and feels connected to his ancestral roots. Though capable of masking his internal distress with outward laughter and jokes, he feels intense devotion in his personal relationships.

_Sources: [v4 c36 P40](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0040), [v4 c36 P42](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0042), [v4 c38 P1](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0001), [v4 c38 P2](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0002), [v4 c38 P7](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0007), [v4 c38 P9](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0009), [v4 c23 P10](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0010), [v4 c23 P11](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0011)_

## Goals

## History

Adrian Treleaven traveled to Seven Gulls, feeling a sense of returning home due to his mother's upbringing there. Upon his arrival, Miss Winifred driven him over to meet Nell Harcourt and Lorna Ainslie. He expressed deep excitement about visiting his ancestral home—built by his grandfather John Tremayne—and learning about his family history from Captain Saul Garrick. Over the summer, Adrian collaborated with Captain Saul to write the elderly mariner's life story, taking a photograph of him at the lighthouse doorway for the frontispiece. During his stay, he fell deeply in love with Lorna Ainslie. In August, shortly before his vacation came to an end, Adrian met Lorna in the ancient garden, declared his love, and became engaged to her under the late-blooming red roses. In late September, his published book, titled *The Life-Book of Captain Saul*, arrived at the post office to the great delight of Captain Saul and their friends.

_Sources: [v4 c39 P0](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0000), [v4 c39 P5](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0005), [v4 c38 P0](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0000), [v4 c38 P1](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0001), [v4 c38 P9](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0009), [v4 c38 P10](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0010), [v4 c23 P1](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0001), [v4 c23 P8](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0008), [v4 c23 P11](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0011), [v4 c23 P15](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0015)_

## Background by volume

- His mother was born and raised in the area of John Tremayne's house  <sub>[v4 c23 P11](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0011)</sub>
- His grandfather was John Tremayne, who built the ancient home and watched for the Royal William  <sub>[v4 c38 P2](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0002), [v4 c23 P11](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0011), [v4 c23 P12](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0012)</sub>

## Quotes

> You cannot realize how delighted I am to be here, Mrs. Carrow. I have a strange sensation of returning home.  <sub>[v4 c23 P11](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0011)</sub>

> On certain nights an odd smell drifts along the breeze in this garden, resembling a ghostlike scent. From which exact flower it originates, I have never managed to find out.  <sub>[v4 c38 P2](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0002)</sub>

> Love was the foundation upon which this home was constructed and blessed. Dwellings like this are BOUND to affect their inhabitants.  <sub>[v4 c38 P4](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0004)</sub>

> Indeed—affection victorious and faultless. Lorna, you are aware—you comprehend. I have adored you since the beginning.  <sub>[v4 c38 P9](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0009)</sub>
